source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: This repository gathers the icons and logos of Home Assistant integrations, organized by domain, and validates and assembles them into a static site with validate.sh and build.sh. Netlify functions also sync and serve the Marketplace icons from Blobs storage.
